edit.description: stub the agent in the stop-flag 'tick ignores the flag and runs normally' fixture, per §The default test lane must stay fast

summary: Stub the real agent in cli.test.ts's stop-flag tick test to remove real-claude-invocation flakiness under parallel load

per.section: The default test lane must stay fast

tests: the stop-flag 'flume tick ignores the flag and runs normally' test passes deterministically without spawning a real claude agent, under parallel full-suite load
acceptance: test passes reliably in isolation and in the full `pnpm test` run; no real claude-code process spawned by this test
notes: minimalChainSrc() declares no agent, so Dispatcher falls to the real claudeCode() agent (src/Dispatcher.ts:1343). Sibling fixtures in this file (jobEnvProbeChainSrc, jobFanoutProbeChainSrc) already stub agent.invoke -- mirror that pattern here. Measured: passed standalone in 13.2s, timed out at the file's 30s cap under full `pnpm test` parallel load (reproduced twice); isolated re-run also passed in 13.2s, confirming load-dependence not a hang.
